svg.aria-label: Before receiving: choose the source and get the invoice
svg.title: Before receiving: choose the source and get the invoice
svg.desc: Before receiving, use the company’s authorised setup to obtain a public original, private original or public copy. Four plain-English routes include private-download failure, whose automatic recovery rules remain open. Safe copy access does not release ERP delivery without the original. Saved files continue at receiving step 1.

g.text: Before receiving: choose the source and get the invoice
Use the company’s existing setup. Check each invoice separately.
Use only platforms the company is allowed to access. Knowing the supplier’s provider name is not enough.
WHAT IS AVAILABLE?
GET THE FILE
WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?
The original is on the public platform
This applies with or without a private platform.
Get the original from the public platform.
Start receiving with the original.
Continue at step 1 in the receiving diagram.
The public platform has only a copy.
The company can access the private original.
Get the original from the private platform.
Keep the public copy if it is also obtained.
Start receiving with the original.
Keep the original and copy clearly labelled.
The public platform has only a copy.
No private platform is set up, or the private original cannot
be accessed.
Get the copy from the public platform,
if the company has permission.
Start receiving with the copy.
Allow view/download after the required checks.
ERP delivery waits for the original.
The private-original download fails.
Keep the original request pending.
Check whether getting a public copy is allowed.
Automatic recovery rules are not agreed yet.
If allowed, get the public copy and use the copy route above.
Otherwise, keep recovery pending.
No permitted file is available? Keep the invoice pending and show what is missing. A failed request does not mean there are no invoices.
Check recipient, file readability, safety and required integrity controls while getting and saving the file.
Each saved file then goes to step 1: Record the received file.
